{"id": "33da8aabe6e16f93a795", "title": "Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’", "url": "https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/18/anthropic-says-its-committing-5-of-its-shares-to-a-public-benefit-fund", "source_id": "techcrunch", "source": "TechCrunch AI", "published_at": "2026-10-18T20:37:40+00:00", "first_published_at": "2026-10-18T20:37:40+00:00", "announced_at": null, "updated_at": "2026-10-18T20:37:45+00:00", "feed_entry_at": "2026-10-18T20:37:40+00:00", "time_basis": "source_published", "text": "In Brief Posted: 1:37 PM PDT · October 18, 2026 Image Credits: Jakub Porzycki / NurPhoto / Getty Images Anthony Ha Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’ Anthropic announced today that it’s creating a “public benefit fund” that will give the company “increased flexibility and scale” to support projects for societal good. Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund — structured as a wholly-owned entity within the company — with the option to contribute an additional 2% for every 50% increase in Anthropic’s value. And it offered some broad-strokes ideas for how this money might actually be used, such as “large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations.” There’s also the impact that AI might have on the job market, which Anthropic has already committed $200 million to study . But the company said, “Given the pace of AI progress, bolder approaches may be needed. The Fund will have the versatility to pursue them.” Anthropic’s announcement comes as the AI industry faces increasingly negative public sentiment, which CEO Dario Amodei has described as “fundamentally a crisis of trust.” If you’re wondering who will actually decide which public benefits are worth funding, Anthropic said it will share more information about structure and governance in the coming months. {"id": "71e1590c6c971a337879", "title": "Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce", "url": "https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/18/disney-agrees-to-hire-the-majority-of-character-ais-workforce", "source_id": "techcrunch", "source": "TechCrunch AI", "published_at": "2026-10-18T16:30:00+00:00", "first_published_at": "2026-10-18T16:30:00+00:00", "announced_at": null, "updated_at": "2026-10-18T19:01:55+00:00", "feed_entry_at": "2026-10-18T16:30:00+00:00", "time_basis": "source_published", "text": "In Brief Posted: 9:30 AM PDT · October 18, 2026 Image Credits: Character.AI Anthony Ha Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce After chatbot startup Character.AI filed for bankruptcy earlier this week, many of its employees will have the opportunity to take jobs at Disney. Character.AI’s former CEO Karandeep Anand recently became the entertainment giant’s first CTO , and the startup previously said that Disney had agreed to acquire some of its assets for $20 million. A legal filing spotted by Bloomberg revealed more details about the agreement between Character.AI and Disney, with Disney agreeing to make employment offers to at least 60 Character.AI employees — the majority of the workforce — paying them an estimated $60 million in annual compensation. The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer. The filing says that despite its “large and engaged user base,” Character.AI has been hobbled by high costs and “potential litigation-related liabilities and regulatory engagement.” (The company was sued by the mother of a 14-year-old boy who said her son became obsessed with one of Character.AI’s chatbots before committing suicide; it also faces government investigations over child safety concerns .) items.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
items.summary: 据 TechCrunch 报道，Character.AI 在提交破产文件后，Disney 同意以 2000 万美元收购其部分资产，并将向至少 60 名员工发出录用邀请——覆盖其“绝大部分”员工，接受迪士尼岗位的员工预计合计年薪约 6000 万美元。报道称，尽管该产品拥有“庞大且活跃的用户群”，它长期受高成本以及“潜在的诉讼相关负债和监管互动”拖累；该交易为 stalking-horse 竞标，仍可能出现更高报价。
items.why_it_matters: 对你做后端与 AI 产品有两点直接含义：一是对话类产品的单次推理成本会随用户增长线性放大，必须在架构里设置成本上限与降级路径；二是内容安全与未成年人保护带来的合规负债，可能比技术债务更快终结一个产品。若你也做本地部署或自托管，可把这当作“用户量不等于可持续性”的反例。

items.corrected_summary: 据 TechCrunch 报道，Character.AI 本周申请破产后，Disney 同意以 2000 万美元收购其部分资产，并将向至少 60 名员工发出录用邀请——这相当于员工总数的多数（majority of the workforce），对获邀员工预计合计支付约 6000 万美元年薪。报道称，尽管该产品拥有“庞大且活跃的用户群”，但它长期受高成本以及“潜在的诉讼相关负债和监管互动”拖累；获邀员工中的“绝大多数”接受了迪士尼的岗位。该交易属于 stalking-horse 竞标，仍可能出现更高报价。
items.reason: 原文称录用邀请覆盖“员工总数的多数（the majority of the workforce）”，摘要误写为“绝大部分”；原文中“vast majority”指接受岗位的获邀员工比例，这一比例被错置。此外，6000 万美元年薪对应的是获得录用邀请的至少 60 名员工，而非“接受迪士尼岗位的员工”。
